title: Why a Small Win Creates a Huge Surge of Motivation
hook: Finishing a tiny task can unleash a powerful motivation boost.

narration.text: Finishing a tiny task can unleash a powerful motivation boost.
Our brains release dopamine, a feel-good chemical, when we achieve something.
This creates a reward feedback loop, reinforcing the behaviour.
It teaches our brain that effort leads to a reward.
Breaking big goals into small, achievable steps uses this effect.
Each small win provides the momentum to keep going.
Have you noticed this feeling when checking off your to-do list?

description: Ever wondered why a small accomplishment feels so good and makes you want to do more? It is all down to your brain's reward system. This video explains the science behind the dopamine boost from achieving even the smallest goals, and how you can use it to your advantage.
topic: Why you feel more motivated after achieving a small goal, explaining the reward feedback loop.
